caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped basket with a large, curved handle rising vertically from its sides and connecting to the basket rim at two points. The basket is rendered in shades of brown and tan, giving the appearance of a wooden or woven object. The rim and base are decorated with detailed carvings of leaves, flowers, and fruit motifs, including roses, grape-like clusters, and various leaf patterns. The handle features a diagonal braided or herringbone design, also in browns, with subtle variations to indicate depth and texture. The background is plain and cream-colored with faint vertical and horizontal lines, drawing focus entirely to the basket centered within the composition. There are no additional objects or elements present in the image.
title: Carved Wooden Basket
